meniscus_level.name: Bottom of Liquid Meniscus
meniscus_level.description: Curved upper surface of the titrant liquid inside the burette; read at eye level from the bottom of the concave curve to avoid parallax error.

burette_clamp.name: Burette Clamp
burette_clamp.description: Holds the burette strictly vertical on the retort stand so volumetric scale readings remain accurate.

retort_stand.name: Retort Stand
retort_stand.description: Heavy metallic base and vertical rod providing stable mechanical support for the burette clamp.

delivery_jet.name: Burette Delivery Jet / Tip
delivery_jet.description: Fine glass nozzle at the base of the burette that delivers single drops of titrant; must be free of air bubbles before taking the initial reading.

burette_tube.name: Burette
burette_tube.description: Precision graduated glass tube (typically 50,00 cm³ with 0,1 cm³ subdivisions) used to dispense and measure the exact volume of titrant added.

stopcock_tap.name: Stopcock / Burette Tap
stopcock_tap.description: Rotary valve at the base of the burette that controls the rate of titrant flow down to drop-by-drop addition near the endpoint.

conical_flask.name: Conical Flask (Erlenmeyer Flask)
conical_flask.description: Sloped-wall reaction vessel holding a pipetted aliquot of the analyte solution and acid-base indicator; its shape allows vigorous swirling without splashing.

white_tile.name: White Porcelain Tile
white_tile.description: Placed directly beneath the conical flask to provide a neutral white background so the first permanent colour change of the indicator at the endpoint is clearly visible.
